ns2:section.sectionText: Intro to Psych. In this Discovery section the same general psychology course content (see http://internal.psychology.illinois.edu/courses/psych100/ for a description), but with more of an active learning approach. Students work in small groups and have opportunities to refine their writing skills. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshman. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
